planner_response.decision: Use the closed finger pair only after measured geometric qualification. Abandon the stalled single-finger press.

feasibility.reason: The supplied RGB shows an open gripper. Closed-pair dimensions, actual aperture and LINK6 transforms are unavailable here, so numerical fit cannot be certified.
feasibility.required: Both distal patches must fit inside the cap, have nearly equal heights, and admit a collision-free approach using public meshes and measured aperture.

constraints.actor_input: English text with categorical signed motion, grip and transition tokens; no images
constraints.success_scope: Count measured geometric cycles only; external evaluation determines electrical task success.

geometry.frame: Let n point upward along the RGB-estimated cap normal. All heights and strokes are measured along n.
geometry.actual_configuration: Use measured aperture and joint states, not the nominal CLOSE command. Transform both finger meshes into LINK6 using public kinematics.
geometry.footprint: For each candidate orientation, project the complete paired distal pressing geometry onto the cap plane. Use the union, not a single fingertip or the gap between fingers. Check the rest of the hand separately for collision.
geometry.pad_frame: Place the pad origin midway between the two lowest distal patches, centered laterally between them. Its pressing direction is -n. Compute T_LINK6_PAD directly from the transformed mesh geometry.
geometry.lowest_surface: Evaluate minimum n-dot-position over every transformed hand triangle; record each distal patch minimum separately. Include all lower protrusions in clearance checks.
geometry.target_transform: T_WORLD_LINK6_target = T_WORLD_PAD_target * inverse(T_LINK6_PAD). Recompute after aperture changes.

fit_predicate.interpretation: The 23.35 mm bound includes center uncertainty, tracking residual and edge margin. Add any additional calibration or mesh uncertainty explicitly; reduce the allowed footprint accordingly.

geometry.clearance: Check swept meshes over every executed increment, including aperture motion, against the table, other caps and surrounding geometry. Require at least 5 mm clearance for nonpressing parts near the target and 10 mm during transit.
geometry.failure: If either patch misses the usable disk, height mismatch exceeds tolerance, or the body collides, reject this posture.

rgb_measurement.views: Retain two calibrated cap views with local SAM masks throughout approach, stroke and release; send only numerical estimates and validity flags to the actor.
rgb_measurement.method: Jointly fit cap pose and visible surface displacement from both views. Use camera calibration and measured camera motion to compensate wrist motion; do not interpret image motion alone as cap displacement.
rgb_measurement.baseline: Estimate the released top surface from fresh RGB before each cycle. The stated 27.47 mm cap height is an initial geometric reference.
rgb_measurement.precision_gate: Require displacement uncertainty <=0.5 mm and a valid cap center bound before pressing or counting a cycle.
rgb_measurement.visibility_failure: If both views cannot support tracking, stop descent and retract toward the last verified clear pose while continuing RGB updates. Resume only after recovery; terminate if the bounded recovery fails.
rgb_measurement.sampling: Acquire RGB and robot state during executed motion and grip actions; add no passive observation-only stage.

action_vocabulary.execution: These are bounded command increments, not assumed achieved motion. Recompute residuals from measured states after every action. Use only MICRO or FINE downward commands within 3 mm of the estimated surface.

stages.name: RECOVER_AND_PARK
stages.action: Keep the existing aperture. Retract upward, then move to a clear parking location.
stages.advance: Entire hand is clear; lowest hand surface is >=40 mm above the highest cap top; the complete open-to-closed swept footprint is laterally separated from every cap disk by >=15 mm.
stages.failure: Do not close or approach if measured clearance cannot be established.

stages.name: CLOSE_AND_QUALIFY
stages.action: Issue bounded CLOSE actions at the parking pose, then KEEP.
stages.advance: Measured aperture changes by <0.2 mm across two successive samples from executed closure actions; measured aperture and public meshes satisfy paired-footprint and clearance predicates.
stages.failure: Reject the posture if closure does not settle or the measured geometry fails.

stages.name: TRANSFER_AND_ALIGN
stages.action: KEEP the closed aperture. Transfer at >=40 mm clearance, align above the selected cap, then descend to a 12 mm pad gap.
stages.advance: Lateral pad-center residual <=2 mm; orientation residual <=0.03 rad; both distal patches satisfy the usable-disk test; two-view tracking is valid.
stages.failure: Correct alignment while clear. Do not descend with the previous approximately 18 mm lateral error.

stages.name: FINAL_APPROACH
stages.action: Descend from 12 mm to approximately 1 mm gap; use 0.5 mm increments inside 3 mm.
stages.advance: Measured gap is 0.5-1.5 mm, lateral residual <=2 mm, orientation residual <=0.03 rad, and both views remain valid.
stages.early_displacement: If RGB already shows cap depression, immediately enter STROKE and include that displacement; do not continue toward an obsolete surface target.

stages.name: STROKE
stages.action: KEEP aperture. Descend in 0.5 mm increments and measure both pad motion and cap depression.
stages.target: Nominal depression 3 mm; qualify the stroke when measured depression is >=2.5 mm with uncertainty <=0.5 mm.
stages.advance: A fresh qualifying depression occurs after this cycle's released baseline and all geometric bounds remain valid.
stages.limitation: This stroke target is a geometric proxy; visible cap dimensions do not establish electrical actuation travel.

stages.name: SHORT_HOLD
stages.action: KEEP aperture and maintain the achieved pad target for 2 native physical steps, without additional downward demand.
stages.advance: Depression remains qualified and tracking remains valid.
stages.failure: If depression falls below threshold, invalidate the stroke and release.

stages.name: FULL_RELEASE
stages.action: Retract to >=12 mm gap while keeping aperture closed.
stages.advance: Actual pad gap >=10 mm; cap top returns within 0.75 mm of its released baseline; rebound changes by <0.25 mm between two valid samples acquired during release.
stages.latch: Increment the selected cap count exactly once only after qualified STROKE, SHORT_HOLD and FULL_RELEASE. Rearm only after this release predicate.

stall_policy.detector: For two consecutive 1 mm downward actions, flag a stall if each achieves <0.25 mm pad descent and <0.2 mm additional cap depression, or if measured pose error grows.
stall_policy.response: Stop downward demand. Retract at least 5 mm, re-establish tracking and check measured orientation, footprint and clearance.
stall_policy.bounded_retry: Allow one corrective retry, within 20 physical steps, only when measured geometry identifies a correctable residual. Correct orientation or centering while clear, then reapproach.
stall_policy.abort: If retraction fails, geometry remains invalid, or the retry stalls, terminate safely with incomplete counts. Do not increase drives, accumulate deeper targets or repeat unchanged stalled commands.
stall_policy.application: Apply equivalent measured-progress checks to recovery and transit, using the commanded motion direction.

budget.enforcement: Use the actual native-step counter if it differs from 141. Reallocate unused steps without exceeding the remaining total. Preserve the release/exit reserve; terminate incomplete if geometric predicates cannot be met within budget.

compiled_scope.adopted: Close in40mm clear workspace, qualify measured paired distal footprint, centered paired pressing tool, native DLS unchanged, current RGB cap displacement and full release.
compiled_scope.not_adopted: The new0.5mm visual precision and3mm stroke are unsupported by existing2mm conditional halfwidth and do not follow from cap geometry. Retain original RGB-derived13.7mm stroke proxy and explicit4mm travel working allowance; do not assert electrical counts. This is a posture intervention, not implementation of every proposal threshold.
compiled_scope.closure: Measured aperture<10mm and change<0.2mm for two observations, while actual public lowest surface>=cap+40mm
compiled_scope.footprint: Union of measured paired distal footprints plus6mm working center margin must fit inside the RGB cap radius. Full hand mesh conditional table sweep checked each action.
compiled_scope.record: Every physical action requires fresh du Luna response; original first-red/stalled history excluded by a new native reset.
